description: Managed browser slot operations for the lease this task's browser_exec holds. The controller key and lease tokens stay inside Hermes. Actions: status (slots, which are yours, handoff availability); release (free your slot now); cancel (drop a queued acquire: request_id = queued_id from a busy result); handoff (single-use link for Danil to finish a CAPTCHA/login on exactly target_id, the targetId printed from current_tab() in browser_exec; returns url + expires_in); native_cancel (one Escape for Chrome's native passkey prompt on target_id); upload (local path -> /staging/<name> in the browser); download (finished file <name> from the browser's downloads -> your workspace, sha256-checked); dialog (answer a pending page dialog from a browser_exec result: dialog_action accept|dismiss, dialog_id, prompt_text for prompts). Pass identity when the task holds more than one lease.
name: browser_control

dialog_id.description: dialog: id from the result's dialogs.pending.

identity.description: Which held lease (the identity used with browser_exec).

name.description: upload: staging name (default the file name); download: file name.

prompt_text.description: dialog: text for a prompt() dialog.

request_id.description: cancel: the queued_id from a busy result.

target_id.description: handoff / native_cancel: CDP targetId of the exact tab.
